title: The leading constant in Malle's conjecture
summary: We give an overview of a recent conjecture of the authors on the leading constant in Malle's conjecture on number fields of bounded discriminant. This comes from applying the philosophy from Manin's conjecture on rational points of bounded height on Fano varieties to classifying stacks. To make these ideas more accessible we assume no background in algebraic geometry, which requires some new perspectives and alternative approaches to the theory. We also give some new conjectures on multi-heights and Bhargava's heuristics on counting with local conditions imposed.
